results.title: Rival Terror Groups Devastate the Sahel - Africa Defense Forum
results.snippet: JNIM and ISSP began fighting in mid-2019 and have engaged in around 320 battles that have killed more than 2,200 fighters, according to ACLED’s West Africa senior analyst Héni Nsaibia. Territorial battles had been confined to Burkina Faso and Mali but have expanded into Niger’s Tillaberi and Dosso regions and Nigeria’s Kebbi state since April 2026. results.title: How the Sahel's Demographic Surge Is Impacting Jihadist Recruitment | RANE Worldview
results.snippet: The Sahel's rapidly growing youth population, disrupted education, weak livelihoods and heavy-handed counterinsurgency efforts will likely sustain jihadists' ability to exploit grievances, recruit personnel and broaden support networks, limiting the durability of military gains.
